name: pebble-watchface-builder
description: Browser-based drag-and-drop watchface builder for the Pebble Time 2, Core 2 Duo, Pebble Round 2, Pebble 2, and Pebble Time Round that emits Pebble C SDK code for CloudPebble.

scripts.verify: tsc -b && bash scripts/check-text.sh && bash scripts/check-icons.sh && bash scripts/check-c.sh && vite build
